label.en: The star dies or is cured

note.zh: 进度100%时1170恒星熄灭；完成项目后方式改为“治愈恒星”（每月-7），降到0时隐藏1175移除修正并静默结束。
note.en: At 100% the star dies (1170); after the project the approach becomes 'Cure the Star' (net -7 per month) and at 0 hidden 1175 removes the modifiers and ends it silently.

note.zh: 恒星变为褐矮星，星系内殖民地被摧毁并冰冻；若知道凶手，可获得复仇宣战理由。
note.en: The star becomes a brown dwarf and the system's colonies are destroyed and frozen; if the culprit is known, a revenge casus belli is granted.

note.zh: 隐藏1165把局势方式设为治愈；进度归零后隐藏1175静默结束，不再有窗口。
note.en: Hidden 1165 switches the situation to the cure approach; when progress reaches 0, hidden 1175 ends it silently with no further window.

notes.zh: 间谍行动“吞噬恒星”（250影响力、60间谍力量）要求发起国拥有带“噬星者战利品”修正的星球（来自利维坦庆典中的噬星者庆典）；目标首都不能是黑洞、未曾研究过侵染、首都星系无戴森球。1125–1140由发起国阅读，1145起由目标国阅读。
notes.en: The espionage operation 'Consume Star' (250 influence, 60 spy power) requires the operator to own a planet with the Stellar Devourer trophy modifier (from the Stellar Devourer celebration of the leviathan celebration situation); the target capital must not orbit a black hole, the target must not have studied the infestation, and its capital system has no Dyson Sphere. 1125–1140 are read by the operator, 1145 onward by the target.

notes.zh: 初始10%，基础每月+3，默认方式“寻找治愈方法”下净+2。20%时隐藏1155加重修正；50%时1160。是否得知凶手取决于目标对发起国的加密/解密比较。
notes.en: Starts at 10%, base +3 per month, net +2 under the default 'Search for a Cure'. At 20% hidden 1155 worsens the modifiers; at 50% comes 1160. Whether the target learns who did it depends on its encryption/decryption against the operator.

scope.zh: 吞噬恒星间谍行动三阶段、发起方确认、目标方的恒星变冷、局势、治愈项目与两种结局。
scope.en: The three operation stages, the operator's confirmation, the target's cooling star, the situation, the cure project and both endings.
